paras: Application: 2012–2021 Toyota 86, 2012–2020 Subaru BRZ, 2012–2016 Scion FR-S Part Type: PCV-side oil catch can kit (Fluid Lock) Part Number: 20-0901-FL

The Radium PCV catch can kit separates oil and water condensation from crankcase gases before they reach the intake, helping prevent build-up in the intake, intercooler, throttle body and intake manifold. Cleaner intake air supports performance and lowers hydrocarbon emissions, and the closed system keeps oil vapours out of the cabin.
hl: Direct Fit: Bolts in using factory mounting points – no drilling required
Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet, 4AN ORB drain
Oil Separation: Two-step oil separation baffling
Fluid Lock: Patented mechanism prevents overfilling and holds collected fluid until the can is emptied
ft: Radium Engineering Fluid Lock Catch Can Kit PCV Side for Subaru BRZ/Toyota 86
